SELECT json_build_object(
  'unreturned', COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', b.id, 'event_time', b.event_time::text, 'pickup_time', b.pickup_time::text,
      'delivery_address', b.delivery_address, 'city', b.city,
      'customer_name', c.name, 'customer_phone', c.phone,
      'equipment', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name', e.name, 'icon', e.icon))
        FROM batutynas.booking_equipment be
        JOIN batutynas.equipment e ON e.id = be.equipment_id
        WHERE be.booking_id = b.id), '[]'::json)
    ) ORDER BY b.pickup_time)
    FROM batutynas.bookings b
    JOIN batutynas.contacts c ON c.id = b.contact_id
    WHERE b.event_date = CURRENT_DATE
      AND b.status = 'Delivered'
  ), '[]'::json),

  'tomorrow_prep', COALESCE((
    SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', b.id, 'event_time', b.event_time::text, 'pickup_time', b.pickup_time::text,
      'delivery_address', b.delivery_address, 'city', b.city,
      'customer_name', c.name, 'customer_phone', c.phone,
      'deposit_paid', b.deposit_paid, 'deposit_amount', b.deposit_amount,
      'equipment', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', e.id, 'name', e.name, 'icon', e.icon, 'status', e.status))
        FROM batutynas.booking_equipment be
        JOIN batutynas.equipment e ON e.id = be.equipment_id
        WHERE be.booking_id = b.id), '[]'::json)
    ) ORDER BY b.event_time)
    FROM batutynas.bookings b
    JOIN batutynas.contacts c ON c.id = b.contact_id
    WHERE b.event_date = CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day'
      AND b.status NOT IN ('Cancelled')
  ), '[]'::json),

  'completed_today', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM batutynas.bookings WHERE event_date = CURRENT_DATE AND status = 'Completed'),
  'total_today', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM batutynas.bookings WHERE event_date = CURRENT_DATE AND status NOT IN ('Cancelled'))
) AS result;
